original_question:
Write a Verilog module named `tracking_camera_system_altpll_0_dffpipe_l2c`. This module should implement a synchronous circuit that delays a single-bit input signal by three clock cycles. The circuit should operate on the positive edge of the `clock` input. The module should have the following interface:
Input: `clock` (single bit)
Input: `d` (single bit)
Output: `q` (single bit)
The output `q` should represent the value of the input `d` from three clock cycles prior.
